title: General Digital currency Circulation Model (based on the theory of adjusted optimal currency area)

context_sources.name: Bacchetta and van Wincoop, currency denomination of international trade
Diamond, Mortensen and Pissarides search model
Mundell, theory of optimal currency areas

limitations: Most equations are watermark-flattened and many symbols collide or split across lines.
The acceptance-threshold algebra is only partly legible and is recovered from the three prose cases.
Table 1 rows are misaligned, so several definitions are ambiguous.
The regression table prints standard errors on separate lines from their coefficients.
The appendix code is truncated and one character is garbled.

tasks: Measure the effect of digital currency on legal tender at three levels
Include why states limit or encourage it
Find the regulatory aims and tools, and the game among states

section_map.summary: Three sub-models: matching, government behavior, supranational system.
Memo: stabilize by widening use, tax the two differently, keep national policy.
Bitcoin since 2009, three tasks, OCA repair of the Mundell-Fleming weakness.
Fixed supply, free choice, independent values, traceable at a cost.
Fisher pricing, three Bellman values, coexistence or exclusion.
Discounted revenue maximized by two tax rates.
Variance ranking, then a two-track supranational system.
130 countries, OLS on 53, Monte Carlo share near 65 percent.
Three country types, strengths of flexibility, weakness of loose linkage.

contributions.summary: One value comparison yields coexistence, exclusion or oscillation.
A third settlement currency wins on a single variance comparison.
A simulated trade share that forgets its starting value.

dependency_graph.handoff: The acceptance probabilities set the tax base the government steers
The variance ranking is why trade settles in the supranational currency
The domestic matching equilibrium still governs use inside each country

assumptions.summary: The two currencies are independent, so one does not move the other's value.
States can trace every transaction, but only at a higher cost.
The digital exchange rate between countries is fixed at one.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Log GDP, profit margins, world currency shares, bitcoin's share.
CPI, GDP, 24-hour bitcoin volume, Google search heat, GCI ranking, 24-hour price move, for 53 countries.
US trade, 1994 to 2016, fitted by a quadratic.

models.summary: Search and matching with two currencies and acceptance thresholds.
Intertemporal tax maximization with two rates.
Expected-profit ranking of three settlement currencies.
Two-track supranational system with a simulated trade share.

verification.summary: OLS on 53 countries, R-squared 0.282, two coefficients significant.
Monte Carlo across initial shares, convergence near 65.21 percent.

results_trace.summary: Big open economies keep both currencies, controlled ones refuse, weak ones abandon their own.
A one-step drop in the security ranking cuts demand 2.95 percent, and one percent more volatility cuts it 1.85.
The digital trade share settles near 65.21 percent and collapses without regulation.

writing_logic.summary: Volatility is traced to too much speculative demand and too little transaction demand.
A published proposal is kept but its one unrealistic demand is refused.
A real currency zone is used to limit what the model claims.

language_observations.summary: A currency's three jobs are quoted, then shown to fail.
A low-acceptance currency is said to fall into a vicious circle.
A classic plan is stated and then blocked by one objection.
A result is reported as holding no matter where it starts.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1: overview of the three-level work.
Figure 2: who matches with whom under two currencies.
Figure 3: world map of monetary equilibria, four attitudes.
Figure 4: US digital trade share converging near 65 percent.
Figure 5: the share collapsing once regulation stops.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Zimbabwe and the United States are treated as already at equilibrium, which sets both thresholds.
Bitcoin stands in for a global currency that does not exist, and the paper flags it as imperfect.
The eurozone is cited to show capital does not flow as the model predicts.

weaknesses.summary: The sub-models are loosely connected, which the paper itself calls bad for linkage analysis.
The regression uses 53 of the 130 countries and the risk terms are insignificant.
The threshold formulas are too damaged to recompute.

independent_extensions.summary: Re-derive the acceptance thresholds from the three value equations.
Rebuild the regression with all 130 countries and report the risk terms.
Join the three sub-models so acceptance feeds both the tax and the trade share.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Choose the settlement currency by comparing exchange-rate variances.
Keep national policy but force states to balance trade against capital flows.

unresolved_questions.question: What numerical thresholds did Zimbabwe and the United States produce?
What form does the supervision cost take?
What quadratic was fitted to US trade?
